definition.zh-TW: 平均每位員工做出多少營業收入。數值越高表示人力的產出越高；員工人數是輸入值，缺少時顯示 N/A。
definition.en: Average revenue generated per employee. Higher means more output per person; the head count is an input, and the ratio shows N/A when it is missing.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
